messages.subject: Project Quartz — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Series A investment in Larkmoor Bioscience completed this morning. Subscription monies have been received and the net proceeds released to the company. The Series A Preferred Shares have been allotted and the investors entered in the register of members; Aisha Chowdhury is appointed as Investor Director.

The executed Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement is attached for your records. We'll deal with the Companies House filings (SH01, articles, AP01) and circulate the completion bundle next week.

Congratulations to everyone, and to Alice and the Larkmoor team in particular.

With best wishes,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0012
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
